email.body1:
Daisy, saw Orum reposition from a dialer into a full conversation intelligence platform with the new AI Dialer.

Expanding the category usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Orum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Daisy, quick follow-up for Orum.

When the platform story broadens, the revenue number usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Orum needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daisy, last bit of proof for Orum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Orum's reply rate likely compares to other sales-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Orum either way.
